CI_UNITS: # Shared candidate-entry and routing inputs. Project and runtime
# inputs belong to each actual consumer below.
# Canonical copy guard consumes the complete executable-source scope.
# ProductionTestOnlyTypePolicy reads every tracked C# source;
# topology readers inspect all tracked projects, and ColdBuildBudget
# counts all tracked D5 modules. These scopes belong to this unit.
# Release contracts execute the report receipt and input readers.
# WorktreeMakeWorkflowTests copies the root dispatch table.
# The ordinary native facets run LeanUtilityInputCommand over D5
# and validate the complete registered module and producer scopes.
# Include their actual readers and compiler imports in this unit.
# Program, fixture and configuration dependencies require explicit coverage.
# Reg owner data changes are handled by compiled inputs inside current.
# The fixture copies this owner's bytes to obtain the hard limit.
# Compiled audit execution in current consumes these runtime inputs.
# NativeTestSupport stages the real compiler and package configuration;
# The lock fixture executes the copied make lean entry.
# CliVerbLinkage reads every shell caller recursively in these roots.
# FileMapEmitterTests copies the resolved repository manifest documents.
# Cleanup fixtures build the CLI and its complete production closure.
# Release contracts execute the report receipt and input readers.

tests-ci-entry.command: bash tools/scripts/workflow/ci-entry-test.sh && python3 -m unittest tools/scripts/workflow/test_ci_detect.py tools/scripts/workflow/test_ci_required.py tools/scripts/workflow/test_ci_compute.py tools/scripts/workflow/test_ci_contract.py tools/scripts/workflow/test_ci_checks.py
